translations.translatedText: # Thursday 21.1.2021 (radio)

The USA's new President Joe Biden has started work. 399 new corona infections have been found in Finland. The Foreign Ministry recommends that Finns do not travel to the British Isles or South Africa at all. Finland's population grew last year thanks to immigration. The weather warms up on Friday and in the south it will rain.
## Biden has started
![Joe Biden at his desk](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1920,h_1080,x_0,y_51/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-764648600943a1a02a9/1611219941)
Open image viewer
President Biden signed orders in the White House. Photo: Doug Mills / EPA
The USA's new President Joe Biden has started work.
Biden took the oath of office at a formal event on Wednesday.
At the event Biden said that he wants to unite Americans and to be the president of all Americans. Biden also promised that the USA will again be a good partner to other countries.
President Biden signed the first orders right away on Wednesday.
Biden decided that the USA will again join the Paris climate agreement and the World Health Organization. The USA left them during Trump's time.

Biden also decided that he will no longer give money for building the border wall between the USA and Mexico. He also ended the travel ban, which meant that many Muslims have not been able to travel to the USA.
## New corona infections
![A sign of the Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare, THL, in Helsinki.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11722496)
Open image viewer
THL, the Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare, follows the number of corona infections in Finland. Photo: Emmi Korhonen / Lehtikuva
399 new corona infections have been found in Finland. In total there are almost 42,000 corona infections.
There are 6 new corona deaths in Finland. A total of 638 people have died of corona in Finland.
## Travel to Britain

![A health notice reminds people to stay at home next to a bus stop in London. The notice stresses that the new variant of corona spreads very quickly.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3576,h_2012,x_0,y_179/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7623466000202be03cc/1614917590)
Open image viewer
The mutated coronavirus is spreading in Britain. Photo: Andy Rain / EPA
The Finnish Foreign Ministry recommends that Finns do not travel to Britain, Ireland or South Africa at all.
The Foreign Ministry wants to stop the mutated coronavirus from spreading in Finland. The mutated coronavirus is dangerous, because it spreads easily and quickly.

Only a little of the mutated coronavirus has so far been found in Finland, but on the British Isles and in South Africa there is a lot of it. That is why it is not good for Finns to travel to these areas.
## Finland's population
![Young immigrants in the Itäkeskus shopping centre.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10694132)
Open image viewer
Finland's population is growing thanks to immigration. Photo: Milla Vahtila / Yle
Finland now has over 5.5 million inhabitants. Last year Finland's population grew by about 11,000 inhabitants.
Finland's population grew because of immigration. More people moved to Finland than moved away from it.
The number of babies no longer is enough to raise Finland's population. Fewer people were born last year than died.
## Weather forecast
![weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11749735)
Open image viewer
On Saturday sunlight may be seen in Southern Finland. Photo: Yle
On Thursday more snow has come to Finland. The most snow has fallen in the middle part of the country, even over 10 centimetres.
On Friday the weather warms up, and in Southern Finland the temperature rises above zero. On Friday evening rain showers spread to the south. Only in Lapland will it snow.
At the weekend new rain will come to Finland. The sun may, however, shine a little in Southern Finland on Saturday.
